correctness.rationale: At E=(1,0,0), u=0 is invariant and every nearby periodic orbit lies there since u satisfies a strictly contracting scalar linear equation. The translated plane equation is exact and reversible, so it admits a local center. Expanding in polar coordinates for the original time and integrating exact finite Fourier coefficients yields T2, T3, T4 with their specified normalization. The two-parameter constraint b=(2a-c)/3+4/9 and T2=0 force T3=0 and T4=pi*Q/4608. The displayed identity Q=3(a²-23a/3)²+(2912/3)(a+1203/364)²+5396458/91>0 proves the claim for all real parameters. The included exact checker reproduced each coefficient identity and the strict inequality. No finite experiment substitutes for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The parameter locus is the complete analytically known center locus of a concrete 2023 3D cubic source, not an artificially selected slice. Determining if these centers are isochronous is explicitly motivated in the paper, and the proof resolves it with a parameter-uniform fourth-order obstruction on the subtle T2=0 curve. This exact structural exclusion is meaningful for critical-period studies independently of any larger theorem; it neither relies on mere computational novelty nor claims global phase behavior.
